collections.name: Japanese Kana

decks.name: Hiragana Dakuten & Combinations
decks.description: Voiced, semi-voiced, and combination hiragana characters derived from the base set.

decks.name: Katakana

decks.name: Katakana Dakuten & Combinations
decks.description: Voiced, semi-voiced, combination, and loanword katakana characters derived from the base set.

collections.name: JLPT N5
collections.description: Complete vocabulary and kanji set for the JLPT N5 exam, split into focused sub-decks.

decks.name: N5 Nouns
decks.description: ~150 core N5 nouns: time, people, places, objects, food, and more.

decks.name: N5 Verbs
decks.description: ~80 essential N5 verbs covering everyday actions.

decks.name: N5 Adjectives
decks.description: い-adjectives and な-adjectives required for N5.

decks.name: N5 Expressions & Function Words
decks.description: Pronouns, demonstratives (これ/それ/あれ), question words, adverbs, and greetings.

decks.name: N5 Kanji
decks.description: The 80 kanji required for JLPT N5.
